title: demo.mobile_otp@v1 send_otp request (EXAMPLE ONLY, not a frozen contract)
description: Example capability for examples/otp-account-flow (HUB-342, HUB-343). Not part of contracts/: a production OTP capability goes through the contract-steward. Two operations: send_otp (step 1, opens a vendor session) and verify_otp (step 2, inside that session with X-Hub-Session). Each operation goes to its own vendor endpoint through its own transformer pair.

send_otp.description: Send an OTP to the mobile number. Opens a vendor session (X-Hub-Session).

verify_otp.description: Verify the OTP the user typed, inside the session send_otp opened.

mobile.description: Indian mobile number in E.164 form.
